name: Voquill
long_description:
Voquill is the modern AI-native operating system for medical labs. This software manages the entire workflow of the lab (accessioning, workflow, reporting, coding, compliance, and revenue) and contains modern agentic AI tools to help each step. For example, pathologists can write reports 20% faster through our voice AI coworker.

Incumbent lab operating systems are old, don't scale with how modern labs work, and can’t integrate existing AI solutions. As a result, labs are either building their own or paying millions for band-aid solutions and consultants. We're building an agentic platform to manage every aspect of the lab and displace the billions spent on legacy management systems.
one_liner: The agentic OS for medical labs

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Michael is the co-founder & CEO of Voquill.

He spent 5 years at Techcyte, a digital pathology company, joining as a junior engineer straight out of college and rising to VP of Engineering, where he managed a team of 55. At Techcyte, he led the AI team and architected digital pathology systems deployed at Mayo Clinic and other large reference laboratories.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Henry is the co-founder of Voquill.

Before Voquill, Henry was a Principal at Oliver Wyman, where he led large AI and automation deployments for F500 companies. He previously founded The Intelligent Worker, an AI education and training company with 500K paying students.

Josiah is the co-founder and CTO of Voquill.

launches.title: Voquill - Voice AI for Pathologists
launches.tagline: The AI coworker that helps pathologists work cases faster
launches.body:
Hey YC,

We’re Michael, Josiah, and Henry, co-founders of Voquill.

**TLDR:** Voquill is an AI coworker that helps pathologists write cases faster using their voice. Over the last 4 weeks. We’ve onboarded 25+ pathologists.

<https://youtu.be/Iw3n94o52Js>

**The Problem:** 

Pathologists are doctors who diagnose diseases by looking at tissues, cells, and fluids. They spend their whole day looking through a microscope, observing patterns, and then documenting their findings. These reports can be repetitive and tedious. **Pathologists bill a total of $30-$40BN each year** **yet a third of that spend goes to documentation**, not diagnosis, which is a massive drag on a field that's already short-staffed.

**Our Solution:**

Voquill is an AI coworker that helps pathologists write their reports faster. Think of it like an AI resident that listens to the pathologist as they work the case and drafts the report automatically. It learns the pathologists reporting style from their old cases, and ensures every report meets the bar for quality. We go beyond dictation and don't generate a transcript, but a finished sign-out ready report instead. This enables pathologists to spend more time on patient outcomes and sign out more cases.

There is already a shortage of pathologists when compared to the case demand. **This gap is expected to increase to 25% over the next decade.** We’re building Voquill to give pathologists the tools they need to work faster. 

**One More Thing:**

Voquill is being used by 25 pathologists from a leading F500 lab, saving each one \~20% in case writing time every day. We started with voice reporting because it's the highest-leverage moment in the workflow. We’ve since found that it's also the right moment to fix billing: as pathologists describe what they see, **Voquill suggests the optimal CPT codes, helping labs capture more of the $8B+ they currently leave on the table.**  

**The Team:**

Michael and Josiah previously worked at Techcyte, where they led the AI team and architected digital pathology systems. Henry was a Principal at Oliver Wyman, building AI and automation tools for F500 firms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101652&key=user_uploads/3291143/12ea3b4b-4f60-4a6a-8e43-07d68b0eb511)

**Our Ask:**

If you know any pathology labs or pathologists that sign out cases, please introduce us by emailing michael@voquill.com. Or, book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/michael-voquill/voquill-demo).
